levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: «أبي» and «أخي» are bare relations (rule 7); the four links of the first level are co-transmitters joined by «جميعا»
«كنت وعامر بن عبد الله … عند أبي عبد الله»: Amir asks inside Safwan's story, so he is in the scene only (rule 5); the Imam speaks in the story and is the last link (owner ruling 5)
